label: CXMT company-wide consolidated figures (buyer-side)
definition: CXMT's own consolidated company-wide revenue, capital expenditure, construction-in-progress, fixed assets and long-term deferred expenses, as disclosed in its STAR Market IPO prospectus. CXMT is a DRAM memory manufacturer and a BUYER of semiconductor equipment, not an equipment vendor: everything filed in this scope is demand-side spending or company scale. It must never be summed into, compared against as a competitor figure to, or otherwise read as, any equipment vendor's revenue or backlog total elsewhere in the atlas. Use is restricted to the cxmt entity.
